title: 이북5도 및 미수복 시ㆍ군의 명예시장ㆍ군수 등 위촉에 관한 규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:28211:20170726:00008:part:1/1
title_original: 이북5도 및 미수복 시ㆍ군의 명예시장ㆍ군수 등 위촉에 관한 규정
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 28211, July 26, 2017>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That among Presidential Decrees amended pursuant to Article 8 of these Addenda, amendments to Presidential Decrees promulgated before this Decree enters into force but whose enforcement dates have not yet arrived shall enter into force on the respective enforcement dates of those Decrees.

Articles 2 through 7
Omitted.

Article 8 (Amendments to Other Statutes or Regulations)
(1) through (147) Omitted.

(148) The Regulations on Commissioning Honorary Mayors, Heads of Gun, etc. for the Five Northern Provinces and Unrecovered Si and Gun shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 2 (2), the main sentence of paragraph (3), and Article 8, "Minister of Government Administration and Home Affairs" shall be replaced in each instance with "Minister of the Interior and Safety".

(149) through (388) Omitted.
